project_name: Pause App Migration - UI/UX Refinement & Audio Integration

home_card_cta.problem: Jarring solid category color on 'Leggi la curiosità' button was visually loud and unintegrated.
home_card_cta.solution: Replace solid color button with a translucent glassmorphic button (backdrop-filter/glass blur, semi-transparent white/dark fill with a subtle 1px border).
home_card_cta.style: bg-white/10 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/20 hover:bg-white/20 active:scale-98 transition-all rounded-full px-5 py-3 text-white font-medium

premium_audio_everywhere.rule: The audio ('Ascolta') button and player controls MUST ONLY appear if user is Premium (isPremium === true). Non-premium users must NOT see audio controls anywhere in the app (Home deck, Deep Dive, Browse, Explore, Playlist, etc.).
premium_audio_everywhere.home_deck_layout: When user is Premium, place 'Ascolta' button right beside 'Leggi la curiosità' in Home story cards with independent press handlers (stopping gesture propagation).
premium_audio_everywhere.style: Translucent glass button with head/earphone icon + 'Ascolta' label next to 'Leggi la curiosità'.

deep_dive_reader_audio_transition.first_screen: On the initial view/first chapter of the story reader (deep-dive/[id]), present a prominent, full-width or hero 'Ascolta la storia' button right under the story metadata/title (ONLY for Premium users).
deep_dive_reader_audio_transition.subsequent_screens: As user scrolls past chapter 1 or advances pages, transition/move the 'Ascolta' action into a subtle floating corner button (e.g. bottom-right or top-right sticky glass pill with headphone icon) so it remains accessible without invading reading space.

reader_paragraph_glow_fix.problem: Category-color background glows/tints behind text paragraphs were distracting and created harsh background flashes.
reader_paragraph_glow_fix.solution: Completely remove category-tinted background glows behind paragraphs in reader screens.
reader_paragraph_glow_fix.implementation: Set reading paragraph containers to neutral dark surface background (e.g., #0B0F19 or #121826) with crisp high-contrast white text (#F8FAFC). Category colors should only be used for accent chips, subtle top borders, or metadata tags, NOT background glowing panels.

covers_integration.requirement: Integrate ~50 missing cover artwork references across story datasets in backend and frontend.

motion_and_interactions.reader_audio_floating_animation: Animate floating corner button with smooth opacity and scale transition using Framer Motion or React Native Animated.
motion_and_interactions.button_press: Provide visual tap feedback with subtle scale and background opacity change

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_convention: All interactive buttons and key text MUST include data-testid (e.g. data-testid="home-read-story-button", data-testid="home-listen-story-button", data-testid="reader-prominent-listen-button", data-testid="reader-corner-listen-button").
accessibility_and_testing.apca_contrast: Ensure text contrast against dark backgrounds meets minimum 4.5:1 ratio.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. In `frontend/src/components/home-story-card.tsx` and `home-story-deck.tsx`, replace the solid colored 'Leggi la curiosità' button with a translucent glass button styling.
2. Add the Premium-only 'Ascolta' button alongside 'Leggi la curiosità'. Check user Premium status (`isPremium` / user tier) before rendering audio controls anywhere.
3. Ensure whole-card press gesture does not swallow the independent press action of the 'Ascolta' button.

4. In `frontend/app/deep-dive/[id].tsx`, check `isPremium`. If true, render a prominent 'Ascolta' button on page load (first screen/chapter). As the user scrolls or progresses past chapter 1, move 'Ascolta' to a fixed floating corner button.
5. In `frontend/app/deep-dive/[id].tsx` and paragraph components, remove category-color background glow/tint layers behind story text paragraphs. Use a clean, neutral dark slate background.
6. Check all other screens (`browse.tsx`, `explore.tsx`, `playlist.tsx`, `read-stories.tsx`, etc.) to ensure audio controls strictly depend on `isPremium`.
7. Update missing story cover images (~50 missing covers) using cover generation or fallback asset mapping.
